remarks: Available for immediate occupancy! Great opportunity to rent a three-bedroom Cape Cod with private patio set in desirable Riverside neighborhood just minutes from shops, restaurants, schools, highways and trains. Gracious interior boasts wood floors and spans three levels including finished lower level, perfect as an office, playroom or den. Main level features a stylishly renovated kitchen with granite-clad counters, stainless appliances and 9' breakfast bar open to dining room; living room with fireplace, adjacent sunporch with patio access, bedroom and full updated bath. Two comfortable bedrooms with large closets and full bath comprise second floor. With lower level laundry room, storage closet as well as attached one-car garage and ample driveway parking.
